args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, which broke tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` import and usage with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.

The PR is now open and awaiting alex's review. I did not merge it, since merging into main requires code-owner approval per policy.
